description: Show each order's payment history INLINE inside the EXISTING 'Received' column of the daily emailed Excel report (api/cron-daily-report.js). Do NOT add a new sheet. The Received cell changes from a single number to a MULTI-LINE string: one payment per line, DATE FIRST then amount, formatted '<DD.MM.YY>  <amount>/-' (dot-separated 2-digit-year date, plain integer amount with no thousands separator, trailing '/-'), newline-separated, oldest-first. Enable wrapText on the Received column cells so the lines display. Example cell with three payments: '25.05.26  5000/-\n13.06.26  50000/-\n25.08.26  35000/-'. Falls back to the existing numeric received value when an order has no payment rows. Applies to the Active Orders sheet (payments keyed by order id) and the Completed Orders sheet (payments keyed by deleted_orders.original_id). Depends on FEAT-001's payment-preservation for completed orders to have payments to show; pre-fix completed orders fall back to their stored number. All other columns, all 4 existing sheets, recipients, auth, and schedule are unchanged.
steps: In api/cron-daily-report.js add supabase.from('payments').select('*') to the Promise.all fetch block in the module handler, destructure paymentsRes, and set `const payments = paymentsRes.data || []`.
Build `const byOrderId = {}` mapping order_id -> array of its payments; push each payment into byOrderId[p.order_id], then sort each array OLDEST-first (ascending) by p.date.

Add helper fmtDate(s): from the TEXT date p.date (usually YYYY-MM-DD) produce DD.MM.YY — zero-padded day and month, dot-separated, 2-digit year (e.g. 25.08.26). Parse via new Date(s) or by splitting YYYY-MM-DD. This dotted DD.MM.YY format is intentionally different from the DD-MM-YYYY used elsewhere in the report.

Add helper fmtPayments(list, fallback): if !list || !list.length return fallback; else return list.map(p => `${fmtDate(p.date)}  ${Number(p.amount||0)}/-`).join('\n') — one payment per line, DATE FIRST, amount as a plain integer with no thousands separator followed by '/-', newline between payments.
In the Active Orders sheet mapping change `'Received': o.received_amount || 0` to `'Received': fmtPayments(byOrderId[o.id], o.received_amount || 0)` (active payment.order_id === o.id).

In the Completed Orders sheet mapping change `'Received': d.data?.received_amount || d.data?.receivedAmount || 0` to `'Received': fmtPayments(byOrderId[d.original_id], d.data?.received_amount || d.data?.receivedAmount || 0)` (completed payments keyed by original_id per FEAT-001).

After each order sheet is built with json_to_sheet (Active Orders, and Completed Orders if it has a Received column), set wrapText on the Received column's data cells: find the Received column letter from the header row, then for each data row do `if (ws[ref]) ws[ref].s = { ...(ws[ref].s||{}), alignment: { wrapText: true, vertical: 'top' } }` (xlsx-js-style supports cell .s styles). Keep the existing autoWidth call.

Leave every other column, the Balance computation, all 4 sheets (Active/Completed/Paper/Reminders), the summary HTML <ul> (do NOT add a payments-count line), recipients, auth, and schedule exactly as they are.
acceptance_criteria: api/cron-daily-report.js fetches payments in the Promise.all block and builds an order_id -> payments map sorted oldest-first.

The Active Orders sheet 'Received' cell shows a multi-line, newline-separated history with each line 'DD.MM.YY  <amount>/-' (date first, plain integer amount, trailing /-) for orders with payments, and the prior numeric received value for orders with none.
The Completed Orders sheet 'Received' cell shows the same multi-line history keyed by original_id, falling back to the stored received number when no payment rows exist.
The Received column data cells have alignment wrapText:true (vertical:'top') so the multiple lines display in the emailed Excel.
No new sheet is created, no payments-count line is added, and all other columns/sheets/recipients/auth/schedule are unchanged.
verification: From d:/OMS PRESTAIR SYSTEMS LLP/oms-dashboard run `node --check api/cron-daily-report.js` and confirm exit 0.
Run `npm run build` from oms-dashboard and confirm it still completes with no errors.

Code-review the Active and Completed sheet mappings plus the wrapText styling to confirm only the 'Received' value and its cell style changed, the format is 'DD.MM.YY  <amount>/-' newline-joined oldest-first, and the numeric fallback preserves prior behavior for orders with no payments.
findings:
Implemented and verified (node --check api/cron-daily-report.js = exit 0; npm run build succeeds with only the pre-existing >500kB chunk-size warning, not an error).

Changes in api/cron-daily-report.js only:
- Added `supabase.from('payments').select('*')` as a 5th entry in the Promise.all fetch block, destructured as paymentsRes, with `const payments = paymentsRes.data || []`.
- Built `const byOrderId = {}` mapping order_id -> array of payments; each array sorted OLDEST-first by p.date using String(a.date).localeCompare(String(b.date)) (p.date is TEXT, typically YYYY-MM-DD, so lexical ascending == chronological).
- Added helper fmtDate(s): parses YYYY-MM-DD via regex (preferred) or falls back to new Date(s); returns zero-padded DD.MM.YY (2-digit year via y.slice(-2)). Returns '' for empty, raw string if unparseable.
- Added helper fmtPayments(list, fallback): returns fallback when list is empty/missing; else list.map(p => `${fmtDate(p.date)}  ${Number(p.amount||0)}/-`).join('\n') -- date first, two spaces, plain integer amount (no thousands separator) + '/-', newline-joined, oldest-first.
- Added helper wrapReceivedColumn(ws, data): finds the 'Received' header column index from Object.keys(data[0]), then for each data row sets ws[ref].s = { ...(ws[ref].s||{}), alignment: { wrapText: true, vertical: 'top' } } via XLSX.utils.encode_cell (xlsx-js-style). Called for ws1 (Active) and ws2 (Completed) after autoWidth, before book_append_sheet.
- Active Orders 'Received' now = fmtPayments(byOrderId[o.id], o.received_amount || 0).
- Completed Orders 'Received' now = fmtPayments(byOrderId[d.original_id], d.data?.received_amount || d.data?.receivedAmount || 0) -- keyed by original_id per FEAT-001.

Unchanged as required: Balance computation, % Rcv, all other columns, all 4 sheets (Active/Completed/Paper/Reminders), autoWidth, summary HTML <ul> (no payments-count line added), recipients, auth, schedule. No new sheet added. Pre-fix completed orders with no payment rows fall back to the stored numeric received value.
